top_and_pixel_contract.contract: Published O/P module board1080_top defaults STARTUP_DIAG_ONLY=0, CACHE_PROFILE=6, HDMI_FISHEYE_PROFILE=1, TILE8_GROUP_WIDTH=64, diagnostic blanking report-only=1. Instantiates 1920x1080 geometry system, fixed correction enabled, Gamma disabled, zero rotation, param lookup tag ed59f83e. No KEY1 input exists.

Input/output external samples are RGB888. Capture truncates to RGB565 (R[23:19],G[15:10],B[7:3]); 16 pixels occupy one 256-bit DDR beat, first pixel at bits15:0, CRC updates low byte first. Scan expands 5/6-bit channels by bit replication to RGB888. Raw correction bypass still traverses capture, DDR processing/result writer and scan; Gamma is a separate enable.

Runtime A/E2 shared top CAMERA_RUNTIME_GAMMA defaults0; explicit1 selects profile2, ENABLE_RUNTIME_ROTATION=1, Gamma1 and static base parameter708006b9. E2 native frozen build flag1 differs from shared default0. E2 selected69-source closure is one E2 top +68 A references, A resolves58 O/P references +11 deltas; do not compile both same-named versions.

A/E2 default runtime switch0 does not identify an O/P rebuild: top DDR interleave/stride and macro16 context already differ. A has seven materially changed same-native-path files plus four additions; 42 shared exports are byte identical and16 differ only in line endings.

ddr_contract.contract: Both versions expose Pango DDR UI addresses in4-byte units, 28-bit AW/AR, 4-bit LEN, 256-bit data,32-bit byte strobes, RID4. WREADY/WLAST are controller outputs; no B response channel. Do not replace this with a generic AXI write response contract.

O/P selected top BANK_STRIDE=1048576=0x100000 UI units=4MiB; source banks0/1 logical bases0,0x100000 and result banks2/3 bases0x200000,0x300000. Each1920x1080 RGB565 frame4147200 bytes fits4MiB with47104 bytes slack. source_bank and released_bank remain1-bit, source_writable2-bit. This is not the reverted/other branch three-source0/1/4 scheme.

Runtime A/E2 selected top BANK_STRIDE=33554432=0x2000000 UI units=128MiB logical stride. Logical bank bases0,0x2000000,0x4000000,0x6000000 go through a bijective/involutive bit permutation before BOTH AW and AR reach IP: {logical[12:10],logical[24:13],logical[27:25],logical[9:0]}. Their IP-side base addresses become0,0x400,0x800,0xc00; a logical frame is not a contiguous128MiB physical frame. The four logical regions span a512MiB logical allocation. The binding-specific vendor IP must match.

Capture AW increments8 UI units per256-bit beat and uses AWLEN15 (16 beats). O/P corrected tile8 writer group64 yields four beats per raster row and AWLEN3; result publication waits all generated pixels/whole bursts/writer completion and CRC. Runtime macro64x16 is a distinct writer context, not the O/P tile8x8 writer dropped into the same build.

mode_descriptor_queue_reset_fault_contra.contract: Actual mode ownership begins at processing acceptance source_valid&&source_ready: bank latches all480 config bits, Gamma/correction, source_bank/id and param_id together; engine start is following cycle. DMA head/tail descriptors contain bank/id/CRC/pixel count only, with no correction/Gamma/mode field. Thus already captured queued frames receive whichever mode is selected when accepted for processing, unless a future design explicitly extends descriptor metadata.

Published top selects frame_ab_control FIXED_MODE1: reset initializes correction1, !failed keeps1 and failure holds it. Other parameter branches can change selection on source_commit, but those branches are not selected by published O/P or E2. Registered public source_commit is generated after the same acceptance edge and is not the mode/config apply event. There is no published KEY1 debounce/toggle implementation in these selected tops.

A runtime rotation128-bit pending held-bundle CDC mux is visible at the bank accept edge; d_ready=frame_accept&&core_release, active config becomes pending only on that event. system frame_accept is src_valid&&src_ready. Registered source_commit is deliberately not the apply event. Gamma remains compile-time enabled, not an SGR1 field.

A stalled valid descriptor locks its offered bank, active processing locks its source bank, source_ready is low during processing/pending/start or display-bank collision. No mode switch may release/reassign these banks. Completed results carry pending_mode={0,Gamma,correction}, then front/display_mode on actual grant; repeats retain old front mode/param id. A UI-selected mode can differ from an old queued/active/displayed frame; new wrapper verification must use per-frame metadata.

Runtime fault is sticky and must not reset bank epoch or withdraw AW/W. Global manual/power reset clears ownership and config; local core release is synchronized. Fault stops admission, quarantines bad result/display lease, and keeps already-issued writes subject to unchanged arbiter drain contract. Display release requires reader completion/CRC, matching pixel frame/bank/epoch/CRC/full count, idle reader and empty FIFO, with !failed. Any future KEY1 control must leave this behavior intact.

uart_contract.contract: Normal telemetry runs27MHz/115200 nominal,8N1. One TX owner is retained until final physical stop bit done. Published O/P enables LIGHT stats and leaves snapshot transfer disabled; stats, snapshot and signature/ACK paths share packet arbitration. This UART observes video; ready/fault/reset outputs do not control video.

SGA1 fixed24B: magic4,version1,revision1,length24 LE,ticket32 nonzero,nonce32 nonzero,reserved32 zero,CRC32 LE over first20B. Held mailbox and timeout2700000 ctrl clocks; full slot drops later valid commands without video backpressure. New signature session arms on pixel-domain complete frame start; stale ticket/duplicate/reused nonce/abort have explicit status. SGK1 ACK is24B, includes ticket/nonce/epoch/status; ACK alone does not measure optical or processed frame rate.

PGSIG001 is128B:120B atomic record +CRC32 +SG01 tail. Carries session nonce/epoch/frame id/param id/sequence/pixel count/imageCRC/drop/abort/malformed/geometry/mode and8 samples. Tap is final registered digital RGB888 reconstructed from DDR RGB565, not physical HDMI or optical capture.

SGT1 stats request uses same24B version/revision/length/ticket/nonce/reserved/CRC schema. O/P response is PGSTAT02 length84B:80B body+CRC. Body includes core rate/ticks,last processed cycles/id/param/mode,capture/process/present/repeat/drop. Last32 bits contain8 state flags and diagnostic fault_detail high24={controller_fault,input_fault,fault}; this is the documented fault-detail PGSTAT02 profile, not ordinary formal-v1 or a camera FPS proof.

Only opt-in runtime A/E2 adds SGR1 fixed36B and byte-exact forwarding of registered SGA1/SGT1/SGF1 protocols. SGR1 validates schema,nonzero request id,base param id,coefficient range/nonzero pair,parameterCRC andpacketCRC. It queues128 bits{derived_param_id,phase,cosQ30,sinQ30}; it has no Gamma field and no standalone ACK proving applied video. Coefficient bounds do not prove a unit-circle/phase-consistent pair; the offline profile-aware encoder supplies it. Need a new session/nonce and new frame id/param metadata to prove effect.

uart_field_offsets_bytes.byte_order: Little endian for all multi-byte integer fields. CRC32 uses reflected polynomial0xedb88320, seedffffffff, complemented output.
